system.description: Your art is considered truly inspired: there is an essence of life and beauty in your work that moves others, whether you were always gifted or the Embrace opened something in you unexpectedly. Your singing voice melts stone, your paintings seem ready to breathe, your storytelling holds a room utterly spellbound. The difficulty of all Expression rolls is reduced by two, or by three if the art relates to God, the Church, or similarly high ideals. Such perfection breeds jealousy in mortal and Cainite rivals alike, and suspicious clergy may whisper that you traded your soul for your talent, or that your reach outstrips the humility owed to God.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
